problem_text:
A logistics company must allocate its fleet of available delivery vehicles across several regional distribution centers to fulfill anticipated customer orders. The objective is to minimize the total fuel expenditure for all trips.

The number of vehicles ready for dispatch at each depot (set D) is as follows:
*Depot D1 has 68 vehicles.
*Depot D2 has 137 vehicles.
*Depot D3 has 93 vehicles.
*Depot D4 has 146 vehicles.
*Depot D5 has 91 vehicles.
*Depot D6 has 69 vehicles.
*Depot D7 has 190 vehicles.
*Depot D8 has 73 vehicles.
*Depot D9 has 136 vehicles.

The required number of vehicles to be stationed at each distribution center (set C) to meet delivery commitments is:
*Center C1 requires 139 vehicles.
*Center C2 requires 109 vehicles.
*Center C3 requires 7 vehicles.
*Center C4 requires 213 vehicles.
*Center C5 requires 38 vehicles.
*Center C6 requires 201 vehicles.
*Center C7 requires 35 vehicles.
*Center C8 requires 22 vehicles.
*Center C9 requires 46 vehicles.

The fuel cost, in monetary units, to relocate one vehicle from a given depot to a specific center is detailed in the table:
| From / To | C1 | C2 | C3 | C4 | C5 | C6 | C7 | C8 | C9 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| D1 | 7 | 14 | 18 | 18 | 9 | 10 | 10 | 8 | 4 |
| D2 | 2 | 13 | 19 | 18 | 16 | 5 | 2 | 12 | 1 |
| D3 | 14 | 3 | 10 | 20 | 16 | 7 | 4 | 1 | 7 |
| D4 | 6 | 10 | 3 | 16 | 4 | 10 | 13 | 16 | 16 |
| D5 | 9 | 3 | 18 | 13 | 6 | 12 | 13 | 12 | 6 |
| D6 | 15 | 2 | 9 | 15 | 15 | 9 | 8 | 9 | 19 |
| D7 | 2 | 5 | 4 | 3 | 12 | 18 | 14 | 19 | 8 |
| D8 | 18 | 2 | 13 | 17 | 14 | 18 | 16 | 19 | 8 |
| D9 | 16 | 10 | 3 | 13 | 2 | 17 | 19 | 17 | 19 |

Determine the optimal number of vehicles to dispatch from each depot to each center in order to minimize the aggregate fuel cost.
